source_instruction: i am looking for a black fast wireless universal charging stand.
query: Hey, I was just out walking my neighbor’s goofy golden retriever ten minutes ago, right? That dog will stop to sniff every single dandelion growing through the sidewalk cracks, say hi to every squirrel that pauses on a fence, and even tried to drag me over to say hello to a group of kids selling lemonade on the corner because he thought they might slip him a treat. I ended up staying at that lemonade stand for almost five minutes chatting with them, bought a cup that was way too sweet but totally worth it to see the kids light up, and the dog finally got a tiny piece of a shortbread cookie one of the kids had stashed in their pocket before we kept going. By the time I got the pup back home and grabbed my own phone to do a little shopping, I realized my old charger had completely bit the dust when I knocked it off the nightstand last night, so here I am. I’m browsing the chargers section and I need a good one, right? Since fast charging options seem to be totally unavailable right now I’ll just grab whatever works instead, as long as it’s black and comes at a reasonable price. Oh, and make sure it charges my phone without plugging the phone directly into the charger itself? Wait no, wait—wait, yeah, I don’t need any fancy extra charging features beyond that basic thing I mentioned, just something that works for my daily use, yeah? Let me know what you’ve got that fits what I’m after.
